description: Alternate-nostril breathing with no breath retention at first. Slow, easy, and balancing.
name: Nadi Shodhana (Alternate Nostril)

phases.instruction: Sit upright. Rest your left hand in your lap; bring your right thumb and ring finger to your nose.
phases.label: Settle in

phases.instruction: Close the right nostril with your thumb and exhale gently through the left.
phases.label: Exhale (left nostril)

phases.instruction: With the right nostril still closed, inhale slowly through the left.
phases.label: Inhale (left nostril)

phases.instruction: Close the left nostril with your ring finger and exhale through the right.
phases.label: Exhale (right nostril)

phases.instruction: Keeping the left nostril closed, inhale slowly through the right.
phases.label: Inhale (right nostril)
